speaker_name: Address by Mr. Faustin Archange Touadera
speaker_title: Address by Mr. Faustin Archange Touadera, Head of State of the Central African Republic

paragraphs.text: President of the United Nations General Assembly,
paragraphs.raw_text: President of the United Nations General Assembly,

paragraphs.text: Excellencies Heads of State and Government,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies Heads of State and Government,

paragraphs.text: Secretary-General of the United Nations,
paragraphs.raw_text: Secretary-General of the United Nations,

paragraphs.text: Distinguished delegates,
paragraphs.raw_text: Distinguished delegates,

paragraphs.text: Ladies and gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Ladies and gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: Although at a virtual event, I am again honoured to address our august Assembly, on behalf of the Central African Republic, on the occasion of the seventyfifth session of the United Nations General Assembly.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Although at a virtual event, I am again honoured to address our august 
Assembly, on behalf of the Central African Republic, on the occasion of the seventy-
fifth session of the United Nations General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: I would like to extend to you, President Volkan Bozkir, my warm and heartfelt congratulations on your election as President of the seventy-fifth Session of the United Nations General Assembly.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to extend to you, President Volkan Bozkir, my warm and heartfelt 
congratulations on your election as President of the seventy-fifth Session of the 
United Nations General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Your election is a well-deserved honour and tribute paid to all continents and, in particular, to your country, the Republic of Turkey.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Your election is a well-deserved honour and tribute paid to all continents and, 
in particular, to your country, the Republic of Turkey.

paragraphs.text: We believe that your perfect knowledge of the international landscape, as well as your outstanding personal attributes are an asset and will ensure the success of our work.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We believe that your perfect knowledge of the international landscape, as well 
as your outstanding personal attributes are an asset and will ensure the success of 
our work.

paragraphs.text: I would also like to acknowledge the excellent work and the results achieved by Professor Tijjani Muhammad-Bande during the seventy-fourth session. We acknowledge his efforts and convey our recognition and satisfaction.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would also like to acknowledge the excellent work and the results achieved 
by Professor Tijjani Muhammad-Bande during the seventy-fourth session. We 
acknowledge his efforts and convey our recognition and satisfaction.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: From this rostrum, on behalf of the people and the Government of the Central African Republic, I would also like to take this opportunity to convey our gratitude for the kind attention that my country, the Central African Republic, receives from the international community, despite your many commitments and requests.
paragraphs.raw_text:
From this rostrum, on behalf of the people and the Government of the Central 
African Republic, I would also like to take this opportunity to convey our gratitude 
for the kind attention that my country, the Central African Republic, receives from 
the international community, despite your many commitments and requests.

paragraphs.text: Allow me to reiterate all our gratitude to and confidence in Mr. António Guterres, Secretary-General of the United Nations, for his sustained commitment to global peace and development, and, in particular, for his constant and multifaceted support to the Central African Republic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Allow me to reiterate all our gratitude to and confidence in Mr. António 
Guterres, Secretary-General of the United Nations, for his sustained commitment to 
global peace and development, and, in particular, for his constant and multifaceted 
support to the Central African Republic.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: This year’s Assembly is being held amid special circumstances, as humankind, as a whole, faces the regrettable COVID-19 pandemic, which has claimed several lives throughout the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This year’s Assembly is being held amid special circumstances, as humankind, 
as a whole, faces the regrettable COVID-19 pandemic, which has claimed several 
lives throughout the world.

paragraphs.text: We pay tribute to the memory of all those across the world who succumbed to this pandemic, which humankind combats daily and collectively.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We pay tribute to the memory of all those across the world who succumbed to 
this pandemic, which humankind combats daily and collectively.

paragraphs.text: Since the start of this health crisis, the Central African Republic, as other countries in the world, has not been spared. Our assessment of the socioeconomic
paragraphs.raw_text:
Since the start of this health crisis, the Central African Republic, as other 
countries in the world, has not been spared. Our assessment of the socioeconomic

paragraphs.text: impact of COVID-19 indicates that my country’s economy is expected to contract between 0.8 per cent and 1.2 per cent.
paragraphs.raw_text:
impact of COVID-19 indicates that my country’s economy is expected to contract 
between 0.8 per cent and 1.2 per cent.

paragraphs.text: I therefore call on the entire international community to make a greater investment in the quest for common measures and solutions to eradicate this health crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I therefore call on the entire international community to make a greater 
investment in the quest for common measures and solutions to eradicate this 
health crisis.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: In light of the many challenges facing humankind related to security, the environment, climate change, human mobility, human rights, terrorism, denuclearization, the dismantling of weapons of mass destruction and the COVID-19 pandemic, the choice of this year’s theme — “The future we want, the UN we need: reaffirming our collective commitment to multilateralism” — reaffirms that multilateralism has always been and remains the instrument to effectively combat certain scourges and the means to minimize certain antagonisms at the international level.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In light of the many challenges facing humankind related to security, 
the environment, climate change, human mobility, human rights, terrorism, 
denuclearization, the dismantling of weapons of mass destruction and the COVID-19 
pandemic, the choice of this year’s theme  — “The future we want, the UN we 
need: reaffirming our collective commitment to multilateralism”  — reaffirms 
that multilateralism has always been and remains the instrument to effectively 
combat certain scourges and the means to minimize certain antagonisms at the 
international level.

paragraphs.text: On the occasion of this seventy-fifth anniversary, it is essential to recall the purposes and principles that govern our great Organization through our commitments contained in the Charter of the United Nations, namely to prevent and remove threats to peace; to develop friendly relations among nations; to fight against inequality and all forms of discrimination; and to protect human rights.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On the occasion of this seventy-fifth anniversary, it is essential to recall the 
purposes and principles that govern our great Organization through our commitments 
contained in the Charter of the United Nations, namely to prevent and remove threats 
to peace; to develop friendly relations among nations; to fight against inequality and 
all forms of discrimination; and to protect human rights.

paragraphs.text: The present session is also an opportunity to reflect on how our common Organization will be able to face the new challenges affecting the world and our societies.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The present session is also an opportunity to reflect on how our common 
Organization will be able to face the new challenges affecting the world and 
our societies.

paragraphs.text: Today, more than ever, we must, in spite of our differences, advocate for international cooperation and dialogue, joining our efforts for a better future for humankind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Today, more than ever, we must, in spite of our differences, advocate for 
international cooperation and dialogue, joining our efforts for a better future 
for humankind.

paragraphs.text: The United Nations remains, and will continue to be, the multilateral framework par excellence.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The United Nations remains, and will continue to be, the multilateral 
framework par excellence.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: No human endeavour is perfect, and therefore we must bear in mind the weaknesses identified over the past 75 years and find effective and lasting solutions to them.
paragraphs.raw_text:
No human endeavour is perfect, and therefore we must bear in mind the 
weaknesses identified over the past 75 years and find effective and lasting solutions 
to them.

paragraphs.text: In that regard, the Central African Republic wishes to add its voice to the call of some States and the African Union for Security Council reform.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In that regard, the Central African Republic wishes to add its voice to the call 
of some States and the African Union for Security Council reform.

paragraphs.text: It is a matter of looking beyond narrow self-interests and giving priority to common interests, while avoiding confrontation, in favour of a joint strategy for our world, which is facing unprecedented changes and upheavals.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a matter of looking beyond narrow self-interests and giving priority to 
common interests, while avoiding confrontation, in favour of a joint strategy for our 
world, which is facing unprecedented changes and upheavals.

paragraphs.text: It is also a matter of African representation in the organs of our shared Organization, in particular the Security Council, which is the central decisionmaking body.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is also a matter of African representation in the organs of our shared 
Organization, in particular the Security Council, which is the central decision-
making body.

paragraphs.text: Through multilateralism, we can ensure a more secure and stable future for humankind, which aspires only to peace, justice and sustainable development for all.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Through multilateralism, we can ensure a more secure and stable future for 
humankind, which aspires only to peace, justice and sustainable development for all.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: I would also like to take this opportunity to share developments in the situation in my country. Thanks to the combined efforts of the international community and under the auspices of the African Union, the Political Agreement for Peace and Reconciliation in the Central African Republic was signed between the Central African Government and 14 armed groups on 6 February 2019.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would also like to take this opportunity to share developments in the situation 
in my country. Thanks to the combined efforts of the international community and 
under the auspices of the African Union, the Political Agreement for Peace and 
Reconciliation in the Central African Republic was signed between the Central 
African Government and 14 armed groups on 6 February 2019.

paragraphs.text: Since the signing of the Agreement, the Central African Government and the guarantors and facilitators of the Agreement have spared no effort to implement and respect the commitments contained therein.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Since the signing of the Agreement, the Central African Government and the 
guarantors and facilitators of the Agreement have spared no effort to implement and 
respect the commitments contained therein.

paragraphs.text: In addition, the Government has made a great deal of progress in the area of security sector reform, which will facilitate the gradual redeployment of the defence and security forces and the continuation of the national DDRR programme, which has already been launched in preparation for the upcoming elections scheduled for the 2020-2021 period.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In addition, the Government has made a great deal of progress in the area of 
security sector reform, which will facilitate the gradual redeployment of the defence 
and security forces and the continuation of the national DDRR programme, which 
has already been launched in preparation for the upcoming elections scheduled for 
the 2020-2021 period.

paragraphs.text: Despite the Government’s willingness to respect the commitments contained in the Political Agreement, massive violations of international humanitarian law and human rights continue to be perpetrated against the civilian population by certain armed groups that are signatories to the Agreement. Those groups are also continuing to rearm through illegal means, thereby undermining the peace and national reconciliation process, which is a guarantee of social cohesion.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Despite the Government’s willingness to respect the commitments contained 
in the Political Agreement, massive violations of international humanitarian law 
and human rights continue to be perpetrated against the civilian population by 
certain armed groups that are signatories to the Agreement. Those groups are also 
continuing to rearm through illegal means, thereby undermining the peace and 
national reconciliation process, which is a guarantee of social cohesion.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Notwithstanding the considerable progress made in the implementation of security sector reforms in the Central African Republic, many challenges are yet to be addressed, including the genuine commitment of armed groups to DDRR and the special joint security units; the sustained support of the international community in the implementation of the APPR-RCA; the conduct of operations and the means for operational engagement; and the mobilization of resources at the national level and from development partners.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Notwithstanding the considerable progress made in the implementation of 
security sector reforms in the Central African Republic, many challenges are yet to 
be addressed, including the genuine commitment of armed groups to DDRR and the 
special joint security units; the sustained support of the international community in 
the implementation of the APPR-RCA; the conduct of operations and the means for 
operational engagement; and the mobilization of resources at the national level and 
from development partners.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: In order to adhere to the constitutional deadline, the National Electoral Authority is working, despite the COVID-19 pandemic, to ensure that the elections are held according to the established timeline.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In order to adhere to the constitutional deadline, the National Electoral 
Authority is working, despite the COVID-19 pandemic, to ensure that the elections 
are held according to the established timeline.

paragraphs.text: To date, the census and dismemberment operations are continuing outside the country and will be immediately followed by the publication of the electoral roll — a condition for the convocation of the electorate for the first round of elections.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To date, the census and dismemberment operations are continuing outside the 
country and will be immediately followed by the publication of the electoral roll — a 
condition for the convocation of the electorate for the first round of elections.

paragraphs.text: The Government is working closely with the organizational structure of the Electoral Assistance Project (PAPEC) 2019-2022, which is built around key coordination mechanisms.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Government is working closely with the organizational structure of 
the Electoral Assistance Project (PAPEC) 2019-2022, which is built around key 
coordination mechanisms.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The Government, with the support of MINUSCA, continues to make progress in the restoration of State authority throughout the national territory, the redeployment of defence and security forces and State services and the restoration of basic social services.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Government, with the support of MINUSCA, continues to make 
progress in the restoration of State authority throughout the national territory, the 
redeployment of defence and security forces and State services and the restoration of 
basic social services.

paragraphs.text: The Central African army is now steadily regaining its operational capacities and I can assure you of my determination to create the necessary conditions for the
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Central African army is now steadily regaining its operational capacities 
and I can assure you of my determination to create the necessary conditions for the

paragraphs.text: reconstruction of the Central African Republic in order to restore confidence and joie de vivre among Central Africans.
paragraphs.raw_text:
reconstruction of the Central African Republic in order to restore confidence and joie 
de vivre among Central Africans.

paragraphs.text: To that end, I reiterate the appeal of the Central African people to the Security Council to fully lift the arms embargo, the burden of which limits our national army in its role as a republican army, in order to ensure the true authority of the State and guarantee the integrity of our national territory.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To that end, I reiterate the appeal of the Central African people to the Security 
Council to fully lift the arms embargo, the burden of which limits our national army 
in its role as a republican army, in order to ensure the true authority of the State and 
guarantee the integrity of our national territory.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Before concluding my remarks, I would like to recall that my country continues to make efforts in the implementation of the National Plan for Recovery and Peacebuilding (RCPCA), which is evaluated regularly with our partners.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Before concluding my remarks, I would like to recall that my country 
continues to make efforts in the implementation of the National Plan for Recovery 
and Peacebuilding (RCPCA), which is evaluated regularly with our partners.

paragraphs.text: While tangible progress has been made, much remains to be done. To that end, we are committed to preserving and consolidating the gains made, improving on our weaknesses and continuing to make progress in the search for peace and economic recovery.
paragraphs.raw_text:
While tangible progress has been made, much remains to be done. To that 
end, we are committed to preserving and consolidating the gains made, improving 
on our weaknesses and continuing to make progress in the search for peace and 
economic recovery.

paragraphs.text: The task at hand is immense and, as the saying goes, “The bird can only take flight when it is supported by the air”.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The task at hand is immense and, as the saying goes, “The bird can only take 
flight when it is supported by the air”.

paragraphs.text: I therefore hope that the international community will remain mobilized in that spirit of international solidarity alongside the Government and people of the Central African Republic in order to achieve my country’s recovery.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I therefore hope that the international community will remain mobilized in 
that spirit of international solidarity alongside the Government and people of the 
Central African Republic in order to achieve my country’s recovery.

paragraphs.text: I hope for great success in our work.
paragraphs.raw_text: I hope for great success in our work.

paragraphs.text: Long live multilateralism!
paragraphs.raw_text: Long live multilateralism!

paragraphs.text: Long live international cooperation and solidarity!
paragraphs.raw_text: Long live international cooperation and solidarity!

paragraphs.text: I thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: I thank you.
